_comment: Identities that are known to be running unaudited, and are deliberately not
gated in index.json. fleet_drift.py lists these separately and does NOT count
them as drift, so that a permanent open item cannot redline the signal and
train everyone to ignore it. A new identity appearing is the alarm; a known
one staying open is a backlog entry.
Adding an entry here is a decision to keep publishing without covering it, so
each one carries a reason and, where a page exists that explains the gap, a
link to it. Removing an entry is what happens when the gap closes.
This file is NOT part of the frozen path spec and no client reads it.

acknowledged.reason: No build attestation exists and the image carries no source label, so its source commit is unresolvable and no source review is possible. Absence was proven, not assumed: repo-level lookup 404s with quota healthy, a positive control on a sibling digest returns 200 in the same run, and the image itself resolves on Docker Hub. It holds container-control privilege and runs on the most hosts of any build of this image.
acknowledged.closes_when: near.ai publishes a build attestation for this digest, or replaces it with an attested build
